# bday -- one row per unit per day of fighting (LAND).
#
# Replaces balance_bday_slots_effects.txt, which spelled out 191,843 numbered
# slots so that a row could be addressed without an array index. A global
# variable map is keyed by a runtime number, so the index the language was
# missing is available after all: the row counter is the key and each column is
# its own map. The bucket walk, the slot ceiling and the generated file all go.
#
# Read from the save under `variables.map_data`, one container per column:
#
#     map_data={ { name="bday_d"
#                  list={ { key={ type=value identity=<row * 100000> }
#                           value={ ... } } ... } } }
#
# Keys are the row number and come back in no particular order -- sort by key.
# Numbers carry the usual x100000 scale. Rows are paired across columns by key,
# so column A's key 7 and column B's key 7 are the same row.
#
# Columns (17), each a map of its own:
#     d        <- global_var:bdday
#     loc      <- scope:bd_uloc
#     c        <- scope:bd_owner
#     p        <- global_var:bstr
#     q        <- global_var:bdrop
#     d0       <- global_var:bdc0
#     d1       <- global_var:bdc1
#     d2       <- global_var:bdc2
#     d3       <- global_var:bdc3
#     d4       <- global_var:bdc4
#     d5       <- global_var:bdc5
#     s0       <- local_var:bcd0
#     s1       <- local_var:bcd1
#     s2       <- local_var:bcd2
#     s3       <- local_var:bcd3
#     s4       <- local_var:bcd4
#     s5       <- local_var:bcd5
#
# global_var:bday_count is still the row count and still the last key written.

# WHY THESE READ local_var AND NOT global_var
#   bdday, bstr, bdrop and bdc0..bdc9 were globals when this file was written.
#   The slowdown fix converted 63 global operations in balance_bd_unit_step to
#   locals -- a global write costs ~124 us against a local's 0.2 -- and these
#   reads were not moved with them. Reading an unset global writes nothing and
#   raises nothing, so from that day the daily log recorded only the country,
#   the location and the standing counts: no date, no strength, no per-day
#   losses. Measured in the 1482 save -- rows 1..3210 carry dates and losses and
#   predate the change, rows 3211..6850 carry standing and nothing else.
bday_increment_and_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = bday_count } }
		set_global_variable = { name = bday_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = bday_count add = 1 }

	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_d key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdday }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_loc key = global_var:bday_count value = scope:bd_uloc }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_c key = global_var:bday_count value = scope:bd_owner }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_p key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bstr }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_q key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdrop }
	# which unit, which fight, what kind of row -- see balance_bd_row_ids
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_u key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdu }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_b key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdb }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_k key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdk }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_d0 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdc0 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_d1 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdc1 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_d2 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdc2 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_d3 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdc3 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_d4 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdc4 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_d5 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bdc5 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_s0 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bcd0 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_s1 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bcd1 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_s2 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bcd2 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_s3 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bcd3 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_s4 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bcd4 }
	add_to_global_variable_map = { name = bday_s5 key = global_var:bday_count value = local_var:bcd5 }
}
